parameters.name: AllocationId
parameters.description: The ID of the EIP instance to query.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the cloud resource.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the cloud resource instance to be associated. Valid values:

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the EIP. Valid values:

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

parameters.name: EipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the EIP to query.

parameters.name: EipName
parameters.description: The name of the EIP.

parameters.name: Filter.1.Key
parameters.description: The filter key for querying resources. The value must be **CreationStartTime**, which specifies the start time when the resource was created.

parameters.name: Filter.1.Value
parameters.description: The filter value for querying resources. Specify the value in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format.

parameters.name: Filter.2.Key
parameters.description: The filter key for querying resources. The value must be **CreationEndTime**, which specifies the end time when the resource was created.

parameters.name: Filter.2.Value
parameters.description: The filter value for querying resources. Specify the value in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format.

parameters.description: The line type. Valid values:

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include subscription data that has not taken effect. Valid values:

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description: The lock type. Valid values:

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: PublicIpAddressPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the IP address pool to which the EIP to query belongs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the EIP.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the EIP belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityProtectionEnabled

parameters.description: The instance ID of the contiguous EIP group.

parameters.description: The status of the EIP. Valid values:

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags used to filter EIPs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.
